{{Wireless adapter |brand=Roku |model=WM03 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=03/13/2014 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Lite-On |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type= |form_factor=module |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=TC2-N1002 |ic_id=5959A-N1002 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM43236B;BCM43236BKMLG, HT1348 P21, 338655 6 W; |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips=2.4/5GHz Front End Module;Skyworks;SE2577L;SiGe, 2577L, 336DY;2; |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=30:52:CB |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This FCC ID covers both the WM01 (smaller form factor module) and the WM02 (larger form factor module).

Per the FCC 'manual' / datasheets.. *The required input voltage may be 3.3v only *The USB ID is noted as 0a5c:bd17, which is probably the default 43236/43236b USB ID
